description: Searches the Ania marketplace for avatars and wake words, with a free-only filter and (for wake words) the language they listen in. Returns ids for get_free (free items) and buy_listing (paid). Prices in the user’s currency. For a visual avatar gallery use search_avatars.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

wake_language.description: Language the wake word is spoken in (what the model listens for): en-US or pt-BR.

name: search_marketplace
title: Search the marketplace
